description: List the documents in a knowledge base (id, name, type, size, chunk count) — for browsing or letting an agent pick a document to read. Wire a Knowledge Base node into knowledge_base, same as the search nodes.

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base to list, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of documents to return

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: Document rows (id, display_name, file_type, file_size, chunk_count, …)
